title: Hunt Protocol Update. New drawers & Voice lines!
author: xcantene
selftext:
Hey everyone! 😄

I received some really nice feedback on my last post, so I've been working on a few improvements to Hunt Protocol's UI.

Nothing too dramatic this time, but I wanted to give some of the simpler areas a bit more personality. One example is the drawers, which now have these gear-like mechanisms that also work as scrollbars. I've been experimenting with using the same design for sliders in the settings and other parts of the game.

A few people also mentioned that the blue and gold color scheme made the interface feel a bit AI-generated. I actually really liked those colors, so that feedback was a little painful to hear. 😆 But it made me curious to explore other directions, and I've been researching a new color scheme that I'll hopefully be able to show soon.

I've also been working with some talented voice actors, and I'm sharing a few of the new Hunter voice lines! I'll be looking for more VAs soon to help bring the remaining Hunters to life.

As always, I'd love to hear your thoughts, especially if you notice something that could be improved. And if you'd like to try Hunt Protocol yourself, just let me know and I'll DM you the link and password for the current test build.

Thanks again for all the feedback. I hope to see you on the hunt! ⚔️
